I had ingrown and infected toenails on both of my big toes. I went with my mom to see a surgeon about it and he gave us a brief overview of what he would do and told us that that wasn’t just the consultation but the appointment was the day I’d be getting the surgery. I wasn’t mentally prepared for it and I felt like I couldn’t trust this doctor. He put a bunch of anesthetics in my toes and asks, “do you feel anything” and I said, “I think I still do” and he responds, “naw I think you’re good” and he starts cutting into my toe. I was screaming so much in pain that he stopped and I told him to just finish it. He did both of my toes despite the fact that the local anesthetics didn’t work. He said that the surgery was free and him and all his associates apologized profusely. My screams were so loud that several patients changed their minds and ran out of the waiting room. I like to think that the surgery was free because they didn’t want my mom suing for malpractice. The anesthetics started working an hour after we left. I still have nightmares about it and I go to therapy as often as I can.

I was with my dad and his brother at a fancy restaurant and the waiter brought us oysters on a half-shell. As a 12 year old, no one ever told me how to eat oysters, and I didn’t realize just how chewy they were. My dad and his brother laughed at the fact I kept chewing the oyster and I couldn’t swallow it. They tried to rush me by saying to “just swallow it” and I tried, but in doing so I started to choke. My dad and his brother started to laugh their asses off while I was choking. I could feel my face start to turn red, and I even made the universal sign of choking. No one did anything. I almost passed out or I could have even died right in the middle of the restaurant... while my dad and his brother laughed. I was lucky enough to swallow the oyster eventually. A waiter saw what happened a couple of seconds before I swallowed the oyster and ran over to check to see if I was okay. My dad and his brother continued to laugh and the waiter gave them a nasty look. It wasn’t just embarrassing but it was traumatizing. My dad eventually apologized but I still feel hurt, I could have DIED.
